### Visual representation of the linkmaps in our data set. 
```{r, 'plot-linkmap'}
#| message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, dev='ragg_png'

library(multifactor)

# Wrangling
library(dplyr)

# Plotting
library(ggplot2)
library(systemfonts)
library(ragg)

library(ggforce)

require_font(
  "Noto Color Emoji",
  repositories = "Google Fonts", verbose = FALSE
)

# Load demo data
set.seed(2612)
tp <- trade_posts()

e <- tapply(trade_posts(raw.data = TRUE), ~group, `[[<-`, "group", value = NULL)

.to_plot_df <- function(x, e) {
  l <- colnames(x)[[1L]]
  r <- colnames(x)[[2L]]
  res <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      rbind(
        e[[l]][match(x[[l]], levels(x)[[l]]), ],
        e[[r]][match(x[[r]], levels(x)[[r]]), ]
      ),
      y = rep(rev(seq_len(NROW(x))), 2),
      x = rep(c(-1, -1 / 2), each = NROW(x))
    ),
    data.frame(
      name = c(l, r),
      emoji = c("", ""),
      y = NROW(x) + 1,
      x = c(-1, -1 / 2)
    )
  )
  res[["header"]] <- res[["name"]] %in% names(e)
  res[["group_linkmap"]] <- FALSE
  res[["group_multifactor"]] <- TRUE
  return(res)
}

plot_dfs <- lapply(tp, .to_plot_df, e)

plot_dfs[[1]]$group_linkmap <- TRUE
plot_dfs[[1]]$group_multifactor <- FALSE

plot_dfs[[2]]$x <- plot_dfs[[2]]$x + 1 + 2 / 3.5
plot_dfs[[2]]$y <- plot_dfs[[2]]$y - 20 / 12

plot_dfs[[3]]$x <- plot_dfs[[3]]$x + 1 + 3 / 3.5
plot_dfs[[3]]$y <- plot_dfs[[3]]$y - 10 / 12

plot_dfs[[4]]$x <- plot_dfs[[4]]$x + 1 + 4 / 3.5
plot_dfs[[4]]$y <- plot_dfs[[4]]$y

plot_dfs[[5]]$x <- plot_dfs[[5]]$x + 1 + 5 / 3.5
plot_dfs[[5]]$y <- plot_dfs[[5]]$y + 10 / 12

plot_dfs[[6]]$x <- plot_dfs[[6]]$x + 1 + 6 / 3.5
plot_dfs[[6]]$y <- plot_dfs[[6]]$y + 20 / 12


first_linkmap <- plot_dfs[[1L]]
all_linkmap   <- do.call(rbind, plot_dfs)
other_linkmap <- filter(all_linkmap, group_multifactor) 


  
ggplot() +
  aes(
    x = x, y = y,
  ) +
  
  # Bunched linkmaps
  lapply(
    rev(plot_dfs[-1]), function(x) list(
      geom_tile(data = x, aes(fill = header), colour = "black", linewidth = 1 / 2),
      geom_text(data = filter(x, header), aes(label = name), size = 4),
      geom_text(
        data = filter(x, !header), aes(label = emoji), size = 5,
        family = "emoji"
      )
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = first_linkmap, aes(fill = header), 
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1 / 2
    ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(first_linkmap, header), aes(label = name), 
    size = 4
    ) +
  geom_text(
    data = filter(first_linkmap, !header), aes(label = emoji), 
    size = 5, family = "emoji"
    ) +
  
  ggforce::geom_mark_rect(
    
    data = all_linkmap %>% 
      reframe(x = range(x), y = range(y) * 0.9), 
    x0 = -2.5, y0 = 14,
    description = "multifactor", 
    colour = "dodgerblue", 
    label.fill = "dodgerblue",

    #label.colour = "inherit", 
    label.fontsize = 16,
        label.fontface = "bold",
    linewidth = 2, 
    expand = 1/15) +

    ggforce::geom_mark_rect(
    data = first_linkmap, 
    x0 = -2.5, y0 = 12,
    description = "linkmap", 
    colour = "skyblue", 
    label.fill = "skyblue",
    label.fontsize = 16, 
    label.fontface = "bold",
    linewidth = 2, 
    expand = 1/20) +
  
    ggforce::geom_mark_rect(
    data = first_linkmap, 
    x0 = -2.5, y0 = 10,
    aes(x = x -0.25 , filter = header),
    description = "feature type", 
    colour = "orange", 
    label.fill = "orange",
    label.fontsize = 16, 
    label.fontface = "bold",
    linewidth = 2, 
    expand = 1/80) +
  
  ggforce::geom_mark_rect(
    data = first_linkmap, 
    x0 = -2.5, y0 = 8,
    aes(filter = !header, x = min(x), y = y),
    description = "level", 
    colour = "gold", 
    label.fill = "gold",
    label.fontsize = 16, 
    label.fontface = "bold",
    linewidth = 2, 
    expand = 1/80) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(0, c(2, 5))) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(0, c(2, 0.5))) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "lightgray", "FALSE" = "white")) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_void()
```
